description: Presidential Secretariat - The Urban Development Project, Land Called Kalalgoda, Maharagama D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition for urban development purposes. It contains a presidential order declaring that specific lands described in detail (including lot numbers, boundaries, and measurements) are required for implementing the Thalawathugoda Town Development Plan. The content focuses entirely on land matters, including property descriptions, boundaries, and acquisition for development projects, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
